_meta.description: FULL 53-province GISTDA satellite flood-area table for the 2022 Chao Phraya (NORU) event, 28 Sep - 14 Oct 2022. Fetched from the same thaiwater-published GISTDA product already cited in ground_truth_2022.json, but the earlier file only recorded 10 Chao-Phraya-core provinces. This file records ALL 53 provinces so the eval province universe can be expanded within-basin (grows N for statistical power). Total = 8,067,730 rai.
_meta.source_type: GISTDA satellite (Sentinel-1) flood-area analysis, published via thaiwater.net
_meta.note: Values are the province total flooded rai over the window. Samut Prakan / Samut Sakhon not itemized in the source table (noted as affected in narrative). Use with basin_membership.json to restrict to the Chao Phraya basin scope of the causal graph.
